name: security-review-only
description: A tiny chain whose only real content is a human-supplied artifact and the final security-review gate (515439a, docs/security-review-gate.md). The builder seat is external: the CLI pauses, an operator (a person or an orchestrator like Sophi-A) pastes the artifact under review as the paused stage's own <label>.md, and resumes. No criteria call (criteria is hardcoded so that stage never runs) and one always-passing mock critic round, present only because chain-lint requires at least one seats.critics entry - this chain's real gate is security_review, not the critic panel. Exit 0 = pass, 7 = blocked, 8 = not_judged. Swap seats.security_reviewer's model to mock-security-block for the blocking path (this file's default), or to any other name (e.g. mock-security-clean) for the passing path - see docs/security-review-gate.md. Zero engine changes: this is a config-only chain built entirely from existing seat kinds and the existing security_review flag.
criteria: The artifact under review is present as the resumed external stage's content.
The final security-review gate ran and recorded a gate verdict.
